name: KromiumKeyEvent
summary: Framework-independent model representing a keyboard event in Kromium.
declaration:
data class KromiumKeyEvent(
    val type: KromiumKeyEventType,
    val keyCode: Int = 0,
    val keyChar: Char = CHAR_UNDEFINED,
    val modifiers: Int = 0
)

constructors.signature: KromiumKeyEvent(type: KromiumKeyEventType, keyCode: Int = 0, keyChar: Char = CHAR_UNDEFINED, modifiers: Int = 0)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Whether this is a key down, character typed, or key up.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Whether this is a key down, key character typed, or key up.

properties.name: keyChar
properties.description: Character value for printable input and text composition.

properties.name: isShiftDown
properties.description: True if Shift key is depressed.

properties.name: isControlDown
properties.description: True if Control key is depressed.

properties.name: isAltDown
properties.description: True if Alt key is depressed.

properties.name: isMetaDown
properties.description: True if Meta/Windows/Command key is depressed.

properties.name: isAltGraphDown
properties.description: True if AltGraph key is depressed.
